title: Illusion of Explainability: A Sanity Check for Spectral Band Attribution in Satellite Time-Series Crop Classification
abstract: arXiv:2611.19889v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Attribution methods are commonly validated through convergence across methods and consistency with domain knowledge, yet neither criterion establishes whether identified features are necessary for a task. This limitation is particularly relevant in multispectral remote sensing, where overlapping spectral information makes individual bands potentially substitutable. We investigate this gap in crop-type classification using GradientSHAP, Shapley sampling, and Occlusion on a U-TAE segmentation model trained on Sentinel-2 time series from the PASTIS benchmark. All three methods identify vegetation-sensitive spectral regions consistent with domain knowledge, while Shapley and Occlusion exhibit strong ordering sensitivity in deletion and insertion tests. However, these properties do not reliably predict retraining performance. Aggregate attribution consensus masks substantial per-class disagreement, with pairwise mean Spearman correlations r

translated_title: 可解释性的错觉：卫星时间序列作物分类中光谱波段归因的合理性检验
translated_abstract: 归因方法通常通过各方法之间的收敛性以及与领域知识的一致性来进行验证，然而这两项标准都无法确定所识别的特征对于任务而言是否真正必要。这一局限性在多光谱遥感中尤为突出，因为重叠的光谱信息使得各个波段之间可能存在相互替代性。我们在作物类型分类任务中针对这一空白展开研究，使用GradientSHAP、Shapley采样和遮挡法对基于PASTIS基准数据集的Sentinel-2时间序列训练的U-TAE分割模型进行分析。三种方法均识别出了与领域知识相符的植被敏感光谱区域，而Shapley和遮挡法在删除与插入测试中表现出强烈的顺序敏感性。然而，这些特性并不能可靠地预测重新训练后的性能。总体层面的归因共识掩盖了各类别之间显著的分歧，其成对平均Spearman相关系数r……
tldr: 该研究通过对Sentinel-2时间序列作物分类中多种归因方法进行合理性检验，揭示了“可解释性的错觉”——方法间的一致性和与领域知识的相符并不能证明所识别光谱波段对任务的必要性，且总体归因共识掩盖了显著的类别间分歧。
en_tdlr: This sanity check on attribution methods for Sentinel-2 time-series crop classification reveals an "illusion of explainability": convergence among methods and consistency with domain knowledge do not guarantee that the identified spectral bands are truly necessary for the task, as aggregate consensus masks substantial per-class disagreement.
